description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2009 World Championships. Beedrill's Flutter Wings searches the deck for more Beedrill, Band Attack does 30 damage for each Beedrill in play, and Night Maintenance returns Knocked Out Beedrill to the deck; part of a Pokémon SP engine, with Luxray GL LV.X's Bright Look, picks the targets. The 2009 World Championships were held at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, California, in August 2009.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2009 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
